code:
/**
 * ModelRouter safety policy.
 *
 * - Model output is DATA, never CODE.
 * - We must NEVER call eval, new Function, vm.runInNewContext, or
 *   dynamic import() on any string returned by router.run().
 * - All structured responses flow through zod schemas in parsers/.
 * - Free-form text is rendered as markdown in the three.js HUD only.
 */
export const MODEL_OUTPUT_IS_UNTRUSTED = true as const;
export const NEVER_EXECUTE_MODEL_TEXT = true as const;
